text:
jess-sales: Heads-up — Clearwell's POC demo just failed when streaming. Their app threw a JSON.parse error and stopped rendering.
alex-clearwell: during the walkthrough the stream produced a few partial JSON objects then connection dropped. Happened twice in a row.
jess-sales: rough timeline: kicked off at :10, partial around :12, disconnect at :13, retry attempt at :15 also failed.
ryan-eng: can you grab the raw SSE output from Chrome network or the gateway logs? need to know if the server cut mid-event or if the client mis-assembled frames.
alex-clearwell: pasted raw HTTP body to me; here's an excerpt from the network capture:
```
event: update\ndata: {"request_id":"42","delta":"Token: Thi"
data: {"request_id":"42","delta":"s is a continuation"}\n\n# socket closed immediately after second partial chunk
```
mira-ops: gateway logs show worker-12 wrote partial chunk then socket reset: `write() returned -1, errno 104`. Also an oom-kill on worker-12 ~2 minutes earlier.
tasha-sre: that errno is connection reset by peer (104). If process died or was killed it would leave an incomplete event in the stream. We saw memory spikes in that pool from a cron job at :08.
dino-sdk: client advice — our browser SDK expects SSE events terminated by a blank line. If it receives final incomplete data (no terminating \n\n) and the connection closes, JSON.parse will fail. Suggest a defensive client buffer combining until event delimiter seen, then attempt parse.
ryan-eng: short-term mitigation for the customer: add a try/catch around parse and append subsequent data to buffer, retry parse up to 2 times. We'll provide a one-liner snippet.
jess-sales: can we get a hotfix for infra so demos don't break again?
mira-ops: I can bump worker memory limits and disable the cron that spikes allocations. Starting a canary deploy now.
deploy-bot: starting deploy infra/worker-pool-hotfix @1891102505, canary nodes=2.
ryan-eng: on the server side I'll enforce flushing whole SSE events: ensure each `data:` block ends with matching braces and a trailing `\n\n` before sending. Also will add watchdog to detect a generation process exit and emit a terminal error event rather than truncating JSON.
tasha-sre: adding a metric for `sse_incomplete_events` and an alert threshold. Also pinning the runtime to avoid recent experimental build that had higher memory usage.
dino-sdk: I'll prepare the demo SDK patch with buffering+retry and a short README note for sales to paste into their demo app.
alex-clearwell: thanks — trying client buffering now to continue the demo. If you can give an ETA on the infra change that'd be great.
mira-ops: canary looks healthy at :06, no truncations in 5 test streams.
jess-sales: excellent. I'll tell Clearwell to pause the live demo for 10 minutes and then retry.
alex-clearwell: retried after canary, stream completed cleanly. No parse errors. Appreciate the quick response.
ryan-eng: follow-ups: (a) server-side event boundary guard, (b) metric + alert for incomplete SSE, (c) revert noisy cron and increase headroom, (d) SDK demo buffering snippet.
dino-sdk: PR for SDK snippet incoming, will link to sales playbook.
jess-sales: closing thread once Clearwell confirms production POC runs stable. Thanks team :thumbsup:
